name: Arachnet
summary: Perth ISP founded 1996; acquired by Amcom Telecommunications c.2005.

events.details: Founded June 1996 with 30 33.6K modems; began as the ISP arm of sister computer/hardware company WAData; Perth WA; dialup + hosting; WAIA member and TUCOWS mirror.
source: Arachnet company profile (Wayback 2 Sep 2004): 'From a very small beginning in June 1996 with 30 33.6K modems ... Arachnet began as an ISP when WAData - our sister Computer and Hardware company - first needed Internet access'

events.details: Acquired by Amcom Telecommunications; site redirected to amcom.com.au/arachnet by 2006.
